limitedSupport: Lo mhlinzeki kungenzeka ukuthi awasekelwa ngokuphelele. Amakhono (amathuluzi, umbono, umsindo) awazitholi ngokuzenzakalela - engeza amamodeli ngesandla bese uhlelela amakhono ngomodeli ngamunye.
mlxExperimental: Ukusekelwa kwe-MLX kusezingeni lokuhlola. Izibopho azitholakali, iswishi yokucabanga ayikaxhunyiwe, futhi ezinye izakhiwo zamamodeli zakamuva zingahluleka ukulayisha. Bika izinkinga ku-GitHub ukuze sikwazi ukuveza ukuthi ziphi ezibalulekile.
engineBundled: Injini yokuhlaziya ifakwe ngaphakathi ku-Novera, ngakho-ke akukho okudingeka ukulanda noma ukuvuselela ngokwehlukana. Qinisekisa le nguqulo uma ubika umodeli ongakwazi ukulayishwa.
engineOtherVersion: Udinga inguqulo ehlukile ye-llama.cpp? Sebenzisa eyakho llama-server bese uyifaka njengenikezelo ye-OpenAI ngokwezifiso.
refreshModelsError: Umhlinzeki kumele abe ne-URL eyisisekelo futhi kube nokhiye owodwa we-API okungenani ukusetha ukuthola amamodeli.
refreshModelsSuccess: Kungeziwe amamodeli amasha angama-{{count}} avela ku-{{provider}}.
noNewModels: Ayikho amamodeli amasha atholakele. Yonke imodeli etholakalayo isivele ingeziwe.
refreshModelsFailed: Kwehlulekile ukuthola amamodeli avela ku-{{provider}}. Sicela hlola ukhiye wakho we-API kanye ne-URL eyisisekelo.
embeddingModelsDesc: Isetshenziswa ku-RAG nakuseshenini lwe-vector. Imodeli ekhethiwe iba yiyo ezenzakalelayo lapho kudalwa ama-embeddings.
importedTooltip: Kungeniswe kufayela lendawo. Ukuyisusa ku-Novera ngeke kususe ifayela kudiski.
noModelFoundDesc: Imodeli etholakalayo izoboniswa lapha. Uma ungenayo imodeli okwamanje, vakashela eHub ukuyilanda.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Imodeli etholakalayo izoboniswa lapha. Sebenzisa inkinobho yokuvuselela ngenhla ukuthola imodeli kumhlinzeki, noma wengeze eyodwa ngesandla ngenkinobho ye +.

deleteModel.title: Susa Imodeli: {{modelId}}
deleteModel.description: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa le modeli? Lesi senzo asikwazi ukubuyiselwa.
deleteModel.importedDescription: Susa le modeli elifakiwe ku-Novera? Ifayela lakho lendawo azisosulwa.
deleteModel.choiceDescription: Khetha ukuthi ungayisusa kanjani le modeli kokuthi Novera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Susa imodeli ohlwini futhi ugcine amafayela ayo kudiski. Ungayingenisa futhi.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Susa imodeli namafayela ayo aphethwe ngu-Novera kudiski. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Futhi susa ifayela elikhulu elithi GGUF endaweni yalo yangempela. Amafayela asizayo angaphandle agcinwa. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Imodeli {{modelId}} ikhishiwe ku-Novera. Amafayela ayo agcinwe.

deleteAllModels.title: Susa yonke imodeli elandiwe?
deleteAllModels.description: Lokhu kuzokhipha unomphela imodeli ye-{{count}} kudiski.
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: Imodeli efakiwe ye-{{count}} izogcinwa (amafayela ayo awalandwanga yi-Novera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Kwehlulekile ukususa imodeli ye-{{count}}. Bheka ikonsoli ukuze uthole imininingwane.

deleteProvider.title: Susa Umhlinzeki
deleteProvider.description: Susa lo mnikazi kanye nawo wonke amamodeli awo. Lo msebenzi awunakuguqulwa.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa lo mnikazi? Lo msebenzi awunakuguqulwa.

editModel.title: Hlela Imodeli: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Lungisa amakhono emodeli ngokushintsha izinketho ezilandelayo.

warning.title: Qhubeka Ngokucophelela
warning.description: Ukuguqula amakhono wemodeli kungase kuthinte ukusebenza nokusebenza kahle. Izilungiselelo ezingalungile zingabangela ukuziphatha okungazelelwe noma amaphutha.

baseUrl.title: Isizinda se-URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: I-Azure OpenAI yakho. Shintsha YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME ngegama le-Azure resource yakho.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Sebenzisa i-endpoint yendawo yakho yokusebenzela ye-Alibaba Cloud nesifunda. Shintsha YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID nge-ID yesikhala sakho sokusebenzela futhi usebenzise i-API key esuka kusifunda esifanayo.

apiKeys.title: Amakhiyi e-API
apiKeys.description: Faka i-API key yakho. Ungangeza amanye amakhiyi kwi-Advanced, futhi Novera izozama elandelayo ngokuzenzakalela uma ikhiyi lingasebenzi.
apiKeys.testHint: Hlola i-/models ngamunye ngamunye wethule isimo sekhiyi ngalinye.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Ama-key wokubuyela ozikhethela wona asethwe ku-Advanced.
